versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "圆桌讨论模式" (Roundtable Discussion) skill.
- Provides a structured, truth-seeking multi-person discussion framework with an AI moderator and dynamic representative characters.
- Moderator introduces topics, manages debate, summarizes with ASCII diagrams, and responds to user commands.
- Supports user commands to control discussion flow, invite new representatives, and target questions.
- Generates knowledge network summaries and visual frameworks at session end.
